title: When Less Is More: Data and Power in Advertising Experiments
authors: Garrett A. Johnson; Randall Aaron Lewis; David Reiley
eligible_reason: Randomized advertising experiment (Yahoo! users assigned to retailer-ad, control-ad and PSA arms at one campaign start); outcomes are cross-sectional post-campaign sales regressed on exposure indicators (ivreg with assignment as instrument, OLS with covariate sets). No panel, no unit or time FE, no staggered adoption. The package ships simulated data (WLIM-data_sim.csv).
design_notes: WLIM-MktSci_v1.do: Table 2 ivreg sales_post_all (t1_saw_any_post_all t2_saw_any_post_all = t1 t2) and reg sales2_post_all on t1/t2 exposure dummies with control sets 1-5 [pw=pweight], robust. One row per user (7,000 simulated rows).
data_files_note: WLIM-data_sim.csv (7,000 rows) is a simulated stand-in for the proprietary Yahoo!/retailer data (file name and the do-file's single import).
screener_notes: No article text or PDF available locally; design read from the abstract and do-file.
